ctx.x: I never did too much arranging myself. I composed, but I never did too much arranging. But I -- I was more of a composer then than arranger. I wrote -- I started writing tunes I guess way back because some of the tunes that I had written I never do anything with them until later. But when I went with Earl Hines, one of the tunes that I had written, Charlie Carpenter wrote the -- I don't know if you knew Charlie.
